name: ComplexFuncBench Audio
intro: ComplexFuncBench 音频适配是 Google DeepMind 于 2026-03-26 发布的 Gemini Live 评测变体。基础 ComplexFuncBench 论文与 zai-org 官方仓库构建了 1,000 条文本到文本复杂函数调用样本；Google DeepMind 为每条既有提示合成音频，通过 Gemini realtime API 运行静态上下文多轮评测，并沿用论文评分器。这是对基础基准的音频评测适配，不是新的音频数据 benchmark 构建。
org: Zhipu AI, Tsinghua University (base); Google DeepMind (audio adaptation)
build_method: 基础：43个旅行API、GPT-4o粗生成、100条资深精标模板与十倍泛化；音频适配：为既有文本提示合成音频
task_type: 复杂函数调用, 多步旅行预订, 音频适配
eval_feature: 多步与约束调用, 参数推理, 长参数, 128K上下文, ComplexEval, Gemini Live音频复用
variant: Google DeepMind Gemini Live audio adaptation (2026-03-26)
task_type_en: Complex function calling, multi-step travel booking, audio adaptation
build_method_en: Base: 43 travel APIs, GPT-4o coarse generation, 100 senior-annotated templates and tenfold generalization; audio adaptation: synthesize audio for the existing text prompts
eval_feature_en: Multi-step constrained calls, parameter reasoning, long values, 128K context, ComplexEval, Gemini Live audio reuse
intro_en: ComplexFuncBench Audio is Google DeepMind’s Gemini Live evaluation adaptation published on 2026-03-26. The base ComplexFuncBench paper and official zai-org repository construct 1,000 text-to-text complex function-calling samples; Google DeepMind synthesizes audio for every existing prompt, runs the static-context multi-turn evaluation through the Gemini realtime API, and reuses the published scoring apparatus. This is an audio evaluation adaptation of the base benchmark, not a newly constructed audio-data benchmark.

drawio_review_note: The canonical identity follows Google DeepMind's ComplexFuncBench Audio page. The official Gemini 3.1 Flash Live evaluation PDF has SHA256 95d11445e3c28b66873f7f4cc689430214897167d9dd0dc76f4247d1b66fe346 and is dated March 2026; its page 1 methodology and page 4 chart were text-extracted and visually checked. Base lineage is pinned to repository c37b284e2f2e03ee456115b7c4b7e537f534be37 and dataset 5dc7739343f8c87aee465931ba66db13a0fb5dd4. Google reuses the fixed 1,000 original text prompts, synthesizes audio for every prompt, runs the static-context multi-turn interdependent travel-booking task through Gemini Live API, and applies the original benchmark methodology. The TTS model, voice, synthesis settings, new split, deduplication, annotation, and additional QC are not disclosed; no separate audio dataset release is claimed. The PDF chart labels the reported metric function-calling accuracy and shows 90.8%, 71.5%, and 66.0% for the displayed systems. The methodology explicitly says Google ran ComplexFunBench with Gemini Live API; Artificial Analysis ran Big Bench Audio, not this adaptation. The PDF's “ComplexFunBench” spelling is treated as a document typo, not a separate benchmark.
